landing.factAuthA: A Yggdrasil auth server that authlib-injector launchers and servers join with no configuration changes, OIDC passwordless login over the device-code flow, and the legacy CustomSkinAPI and USM read surfaces.
landing.factAuthQ: Which launcher login protocols does it speak?
landing.factDbA: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL or SQLite: MariaDB shares the MySQL tree, each of the three engines has its own complete set of schema migrations, and the deployable is still one Go binary.
landing.factDbQ: Which databases can it run on?
landing.factExtA: Plugin and theme packages pulled from the marketplace are checked against an Ed25519 signature before install, and a plugin runs in a goja sandbox with every capability it uses declared in its manifest.
landing.factExtQ: Are plugins and themes installed under a signature check?
landing.factMigrateA: Yes — the importer copies users, game profiles and textures with primary keys preserved 1:1, carries the original player UUIDs and legacy password hashes over unchanged, and a run is repeatable after a read-only pre-flight and a dry-run.
landing.factMigrateQ: Can an existing blessing-skin-server site migrate its data?
landing.factPublicA: The library listing and every public texture page are rendered on the server, so an anonymous visitor with JavaScript turned off can still read the page and download the texture PNG.
landing.factPublicQ: What is readable without an account?
